tierReason: Products with recipe costs, selling price and profit are new persisted money data; fits one cycle after #12

decisions.decision: Costs are computed on the phone from current ingredient prices; only inputs are stored
decisions.why: A price change then needs no backfill and R12 holds automatically

decisions.decision: Default lines start ticked with amount 1 for portion and 0 for weight/volume
decisions.why: A default weight ingredient has no sensible amount; 0 makes the member fill it in

decisions.decision: Project extra costs are copied into a size; later changes don't touch existing sizes
decisions.why: Approved assumption 8; per-size amounts differ (S/M/L ice)

decisions.decision: Hint rounds up to 1.000 VND or 0,10 USD; target margin 1-95 per project, default 65
decisions.why: Approved assumption 9; USD needs its own step

decisions.decision: Default recipe lines are tappable to set their amount and tickable
decisions.why: Weight/volume defaults start at 0 and must be filled in

decisions.decision: Non-default extra costs can be removed from a size
decisions.why: Spec silent; mirrors non-default ingredient lines

decisions.decision: Ingredient delete is checked locally first and shows the 1g dialog at once; server 409 remains the guard

findings.text: B1 money: projects/routes.ts ~L172-182 currency lock only counts ingredients; extra costs, size extras and selling prices are also minor units, so VND 30.000 price becomes 300 USD after a switch; also refuse when any ExtraCost, SizeExtra or non-null sellingPrice exists, with a route test
N1 api: products/routes.ts ~L190 and extraCosts POST return 409 id_conflict for another project's id (deliberate, as ideas/ingredients)
N2 data: editSize/prepareLines replace line and extra rows on each winning write; foreign extra id gives 409 id_conflict; acceptable
N3 api: products/routes.ts L361-366 price/lines validated before LWW, so a stale losing edit can be refused (400/409) instead of ignored; phone shows rejected notice
